description: Returns tenders that were added, changed or closed after the given time (up to 30 days back), oldest change first. Use next_cursor from the response to continue. Optional cpv filter.

cpv.description: CPV codes or prefixes, comma-separated, e.g. "72" (all IT services), "45233000", "79340000,79341000". Use list_cpv to find codes.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call (instead of since)

name: changes_since
title: New, changed and closed tenders since a time
